sources.title: GitHub - kaushik-ar/Drone-RF-spectrogram-classification
sources.snippet: This repository implements a drone classification system that treats RF (radio-frequency) signal classification as a computer vision task. Raw IQ data are converted into optimized spectrogram images and classified using transfer learning with pre-trained convolutional neural networks.
